Register and Restore Model Parameters

parameter_plan.Rd

Prepare model-independent parameter coordinates and component reconstruction.

Usage

parameter_plan(components, prefixes = names(components),
               named = character(), reduced = TRUE)

Arguments

components

Named list of numeric matrices/scalars, functions or NULL.

prefixes

Matrix name prefixes, a character vector matching components.

named

Names of explicit named parameter-vector components. Their names are retained; equal starting values do not imply sharing.

reduced

Share equal starting values within each matrix?

Value

A locked environment with start, the full starting vector, and restore(param), returning a named list of matrices, functions and vectors.

Details

Components are visited in list order. Matrix naming and sharing match hfit. Function parameters come from their named numeric param defaults, evaluated in the original environment; function bodies are not called. Names shared across components identify one parameter. Conflicting starts warn and use the first value. Functions retain their environments and binding semantics. No model, optimizer, initialization policy or random generator is supplied by this API. External function environments remain references; evaluating user parameter defaults can have side effects.

Restore accepts the full vector in starting order, or exactly its names in any order. Nonfinite proposals are retained for the objective to handle. Fixed/free selectors and constraints use this full coordinate order and are handled by the optimizer layer. Create a new plan when definitions change.

Examples

plan <- parameter_plan(list(mu = matrix(c(.2, .2), 2),
  residual = c(shape = 2, rate = 2)), named = "residual")
plan$start
#>   mu1 shape  rate 
#>   0.2   2.0   2.0 
plan$restore(plan$start)
#> $mu
#>      [,1]
#> [1,]  0.2
#> [2,]  0.2
#> 
#> $residual
#> shape  rate 
#>     2     2 
#>
